description: Source code for the Idle Air Control valve thread in a vehicle engine management system, managing idle RPM, PWM or stepper control, and PID regulation.

classes.name: Pid
classes.description: PID controller class for idle regulation.

classes.name: PidCic
classes.description: PID controller with CIC integrator for advanced control.

classes.name: SimplePwm
classes.description: Class for PWM control of idle solenoid.

classes.name: StepperMotor
classes.description: Stepper motor control class for idle valve.

methods.name: idleDebug
methods.description: Logs debug messages related to idle control.

methods.name: showIdleInfo
methods.description: Displays current idle control configuration and status.

methods.name: setIdleMode
methods.description: Sets the idle control mode (auto/manual).

methods.name: applyIACposition
methods.description: Applies the specified IAC position via PWM or stepper.

methods.name: manualIdleController
methods.description: Calculates idle position in manual mode based on CLT correction.

methods.name: setIdleValvePosition
methods.description: Sets the idle valve position percentage.

methods.name: blipIdle
methods.description: Temporarily blips the idle valve for acceleration enrichment.

methods.name: finishIdleTestIfNeeded
methods.description: Stops idle test if the duration has elapsed.

methods.name: undoIdleBlipIfNeeded
methods.description: Ends idle blip if the duration has elapsed.

methods.name: getIdlePosition
methods.description: Returns current idle position.

methods.name: automaticIdleController
methods.description: Calculates idle position in automatic mode using PID.

methods.name: ivThread
methods.description: Main thread function for idle control loop.

methods.name: setTargetIdleRpm
methods.description: Sets target idle RPM.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Updates PID factors.

methods.name: setIdleOffset
methods.description: Sets PID offset.

methods.name: setIdlePFactor
methods.description: Sets PID P factor.

methods.name: setIdleIFactor
methods.description: Sets PID I factor.

methods.name: setIdleDFactor
methods.description: Sets PID D factor.

methods.name: setIdleDT
methods.description: Sets PID period.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeIdleCallback
methods.description: Handles configuration changes for idle control.

methods.name: startIdleBench
methods.description: Runs idle valve bench test.

methods.name: setDefaultIdleParameters
methods.description: Resets PID parameters to defaults.

methods.name: applyIdleSolenoidPinState
methods.description: Sets PWM or stepper output for idle valve.

methods.name: initIdleHardware
methods.description: Initializes PWM or stepper hardware for idle control.

methods.name: startIdleThread
methods.description: Starts the idle control thread and initializes hardware.
